terms.comment: verbum passīvum, a passive verb; genus passīvum, the passive voice. Quintilian also calls the passive patiendī modus, the mode of suffering, and says of a deponent that it habet nātūram patiendī (1.6.10).

evidence: Quint. 1.6.26: quōmodo autem quīre et ruere vel in praeterita patiendī modō … trānsībunt?

sources: Lewis & Short: passivus · Lewis & Short: modus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 227, 241, 248, 357.
